title: Privacy-preserving reinforcement learning green certificate trading method in energy internet
assignee: State Grid Heilongjiang Electric Power Co Ltd

pse.problem: The method aims to address the challenge of ensuring data privacy while accurately predicting wind power capacity for green certificate scheduling in energy internet.
pse.solution_function: The invention presents a reinforcement learning approach that generates synthetic renewable energy data with privacy protection, enabling accurate prediction without data leakage.
pse.solution_structure: The solution involves multiple agents using the BGAN generative model algorithm to generate data, with each agent's samples being unique and distinct from other data sets in the system.
pse.solution_implementation: The BGAN architecture learns to generate synthetic data based on historical wind farm data, ensuring privacy by making each agent's samples similar only to their own data set and not adjacent ones.
pse.effect: This solution improves the accuracy of renewable energy generation prediction while maintaining privacy, thereby enhancing power and green certificate scheduling under the green certificate trading model in the energy internet.
